name: @nats-io/nkeys
description: A public-key signature system based on Ed25519 for the NATS ecosystem in javascript

scripts.fmt: deno fmt src/ examples/ modules/ test/ node_test/
scripts.stage: npm run generate && tsc && npm run build-esm
scripts.prepare: npm run clean && npm run stage
scripts.test: npm run prepare && npm run check-package && npm run test-deno && npm run test-node
scripts.doc: rm -Rf docs && npm run stage && node_modules/.bin/typedoc --out docs/ && touch ./docs/.nojekyll
scripts.build-esm: tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('lib/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({type: 'module', sideEffects: false}) + '\n')"

author: The NATS Authors
